correctness.rationale: The identities 10^6-1=9*111111 and R_(m+6)-R_m=10^m*111111 reduce all unbounded lengths and all positive centers to six times 111111 modular states. Exact integer gcd and independent prime-wise inverse-root criteria were evaluated and compared on all 666666 states, yielding the claimed counts. A smaller 37037-residue calculation for digits 3 and 9 and explicit digit-1 obstructions proves the stated necessary condition. The supplied complete standard-library verifier replays all exhaustive arithmetic in seconds; no prime-distribution assumption or untested extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The particular six-digit repunit and its five prime factors are a canonical earliest effective covering certificate in Wu 2015, not an arbitrary subset. The exact spectrum rigorously explains why this entire certificate family cannot disprove the observed multiple-of-three restriction outside even-digit multiples of eleven, over unbounded centers; source previously only reported a bounded search pattern. The twenty-class exception count in length classes two and four gives a natural complete finite invariant useful for designing alternative covers.
